title: Cyrus and the Blue Hour
author: Ada Crane
blurb: Emrys Fairweather, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
